about: Which record fields the record-lane comparator (_geometry-harness/recordrows.py) does NOT compare as authored game data, named exactly as the generated schema reference (mutagen-reference/references/*.jsonl) names them. Everything else the schema lists for a record type is compared. A field whose type is, or transitively contains, another major record is a child record and is decided by the schema, not listed here. Every name below must exist in the schema; tests/test_recordrows.py case 1 fails on one that does not. runtimeMerged mirrors runtime-merged-data.md's table where the schema models the field: DIAL's info count (TIFC) and the story-manager nodes' child (SNAM) are not fields of the generated schema, so they cannot be listed and are not compared either way.
